mapper.sql: t.id,t.title,t.prompt,t.schedule_type AS scheduleType, DATE_FORMAT(t.run_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS runAt, t.cron_expression AS cronExpression,t.interval_seconds AS intervalSeconds, t.timezone,t.status, DATE_FORMAT(t.next_run_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS nextRunAt, DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(t.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS updatedAt

r.id,r.task_id AS taskId, DATE_FORMAT(r.scheduled_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS scheduledAt, r.status,r.result_conversation_id AS resultConversationId,r.read_flag AS readFlag, r.error_code AS errorCode,r.error_message AS errorMessage, DATE_FORMAT(r.started_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS startedAt, DATE_FORMAT(r.finished_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS finishedAt, DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM agent_scheduled_task WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_scheduled_task WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1 AND status IN ('ACTIVE','PAUSED')
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_scheduled_task SET role_id=#{roleId},title=#{title},prompt=#{prompt},schedule_type=#{scheduleType},run_at=#{runAt}, cron_expression=#{cronExpression},interval_seconds=#{intervalSeconds},timezone=#{timezone}, next_run_at=CASE WHEN status='ACTIVE' THEN #{nextRunAt} ELSE NULL END, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{taskId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1
mapper.select:
SELECT , (SELECT r.status FROM agent_scheduled_task_run r WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.delete_flag=1 ORDER BY r.scheduled_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestRunStatus FROM agent_scheduled_task t
ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT , (SELECT r.status FROM agent_scheduled_task_run r WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.delete_flag=1 ORDER BY r.scheduled_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestRunStatus FROM agent_scheduled_task t WHERE t.id=#{taskId} AND t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.delete_flag=1

SELECT id,schedule_type AS scheduleType,run_at AS runAt, cron_expression AS cronExpression,interval_seconds AS intervalSeconds, timezone,status FROM agent_scheduled_task WHERE id=#{taskId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_scheduled_task_run r JOIN agent_scheduled_task t ON t.id=r.task_id WHERE r.task_id=#{taskId} AND r.delete_flag=1 AND t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.delete_flag=1

SELECT FROM agent_scheduled_task_run r JOIN agent_scheduled_task t ON t.id=r.task_id WHERE r.task_id=#{taskId} AND r.delete_flag=1 AND t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.delete_flag=1 ORDER BY r.scheduled_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ,r.result_payload AS resultPayload, t.title,t.prompt,t.user_id AS userId FROM agent_scheduled_task_run r JOIN agent_scheduled_task t ON t.id=r.task_id WHERE r.id=#{runId} AND r.delete_flag=1 AND t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.delete_flag=1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_scheduled_task_run r JOIN agent_scheduled_task t ON t.id=r.task_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.delete_flag=1 AND r.delete_flag=1 AND r.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') AND r.read_flag=0

SELECT ,t.title FROM agent_scheduled_task_run r JOIN agent_scheduled_task t ON t.id=r.task_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.delete_flag=1 AND r.delete_flag=1 AND r.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') AND r.read_flag=0 ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_scheduled_task SET status='ACTIVE',next_run_at=#{nextRunAt},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{taskId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1 AND status='PAUSED'
UPDATE agent_scheduled_task SET status='PAUSED',next_run_at=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{taskId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1 AND status='ACTIVE'

UPDATE agent_scheduled_task t LEFT JOIN agent_scheduled_task_run r ON r.task_id=t.id AND r.delete_flag=1 AND r.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') SET t.delete_flag=0,t.next_run_at=NULL,t.updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), r.status='FAILED',r.error_code='scheduled_task_discarded', r.error_message='定时任务已删除',r.finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), r.updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),r.execution_token_hash=NULL, r.execution_token_expires_at=NULL WHERE t.id=#{taskId} AND t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.delete_flag=1
mapper.select: SELECT id,schedule_type AS scheduleType,run_at AS runAt, cron_expression AS cronExpression,interval_seconds AS intervalSeconds, timezone,next_run_at AS nextRunAt FROM agent_scheduled_task WHERE delete_flag=1 AND status='ACTIVE' AND next_run_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_run_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_scheduled_task SET status='COMPLETED',next_run_at=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{taskId} AND schedule_type='ONCE' AND delete_flag=1

UPDATE agent_scheduled_task_run SET status='RUNNING',started_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), execution_token_hash=#{tokenHash}, execution_token_expires_at=#{tokenExpiresAt} WHERE id=#{runId} AND delete_flag=1 AND status='PENDING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_scheduled_task t WHERE t.id=agent_scheduled_task_run.task_id AND t.delete_flag=1)
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS runId,r.task_id AS taskId,t.user_id AS userId,t.org_code AS orgCode, t.title,t.prompt,t.timezone, DATE_FORMAT(r.scheduled_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS scheduledAt FROM agent_scheduled_task_run r JOIN agent_scheduled_task t ON t.id=r.task_id WHERE r.id=#{runId} AND r.delete_flag=1 AND r.status='RUNNING' AND t.delete_flag=1

SELECT r.id AS runId,r.task_id AS taskId,t.user_id AS userId,t.org_code AS orgCode, t.role_id AS roleId FROM agent_scheduled_task_run r JOIN agent_scheduled_task t ON t.id=r.task_id WHERE r.id=#{runId} AND r.delete_flag=1 AND r.status='PENDING' AND t.delete_flag=1

SELECT r.id AS runId,r.task_id AS taskId,t.user_id AS userId,t.org_code AS orgCode, t.role_id AS roleId,t.prompt,t.timezone, DATE_FORMAT(r.scheduled_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS scheduledAt, DATE_FORMAT(r.execution_token_expires_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS expiresAt, r.execution_token_hash AS tokenHash FROM agent_scheduled_task_run r JOIN agent_scheduled_task t ON t.id=r.task_id WHERE r.execution_token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND r.delete_flag=1 AND r.status='RUNNING' AND r.execution_token_expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND t.delete_flag=1 AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL AND t.user_id<>'' AND t.org_code IS NOT NULL AND t.org_code<>'' AND t.role_id IS NOT NULL AND t.role_id<>''
SELECT id,task_id AS taskId,status FROM agent_scheduled_task_run WHERE id=#{runId} AND delete_flag=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_scheduled_task_run SET status='SUCCEEDED',result_payload=#{resultPayload}, finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), execution_token_hash=NULL,execution_token_expires_at=NULL WHERE id=#{runId} AND delete_flag=1 AND status='RUNNING'

UPDATE agent_scheduled_task_run SET status='FAILED',error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage}, finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), execution_token_hash=NULL,execution_token_expires_at=NULL WHERE id=#{runId} AND delete_flag=1 AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')

UPDATE agent_scheduled_task_run r JOIN agent_scheduled_task t ON t.id=r.task_id SET r.status='FAILED',r.error_code='scheduled_run_timeout', r.error_message='定时任务执行超时',r.finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), r.updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),r.execution_token_hash=NULL, r.execution_token_expires_at=NULL, t.status=CASE WHEN t.schedule_type='ONCE' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE t.status END, t.updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE r.delete_flag=1 AND r.status='RUNNING' AND r.started_at<DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL #{maxRunSeconds} SECOND)
UPDATE agent_scheduled_task_run SET read_flag=1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{runId}
UPDATE agent_scheduled_task_run SET result_conversation_id=#{conversationId},read_flag=1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{runId} AND result_conversation_id IS NULL
